desc.en: A four-legged Slag that patrols around ruins. It has high detection abilities and combat capacity. While it's a troublesome enemy alone, this watchdog also calls other Slags, cutting off the intruder's escape routes.
desc.ja: 遺跡を歩き回っている四足歩行のスラグ。高い索敵能力と戦闘力を持っており、単独でも厄介な上に他のスラグを呼び寄せて、侵入者の退路を断つ遺跡の番犬
